assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: wide panoramic background texture for a native automotive 3D scene. Create a photoreal white Arctic snow mountain landscape in soft overcast daylight. Wide 2:1 composition, pale winter sky occupying the upper third, distant continuous snow-covered mountain peaks across the middle, and an uninterrupted level snowfield occupying the bottom third. Bright white snow with delicate cool grey-blue shadow detail, softly lit, realistic photographic depth and clear readable mountain forms. The mountains meet the snowfield naturally around 60 percent image height. Left and right sides should join with visually similar sky, mountain scale and snowfield height when used as a repeating cylinder panorama. The snowfield and sky use neutral snowy whites, not saturated cyan. No foreground stage, circular platform, ring, car, people, trees, buildings, water, roadway, sunlight flare, text, borders, vignette, or artificial blur.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless square albedo ground texture for an Arctic automotive 3D scene.
